outputs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. THREE full-body original Bogbell Maul battle animation paintings, THREE columns ONE row with generous empty gutters. BOTH hands hold ONE complete wooden maul, barrel-shaped wood cylinder head at screen RIGHT with three brass riveted hoops and small hanging bells, flared butt and small bell at screen LEFT. Keep reference shaft length and barrel size relative to torso, no giant new weapon. Same elevated three-quarter camera facing RIGHT, consistent full-body size. LEFT: recovery after downward strike, torso halfway straightening, hands pull complete maul upward to waist, barrel still low on RIGHT just above ground, wrists separated on handle. CENTER: upright ready defense, knees slightly bent, unchanged maul shaft diagonally across lower chest, barrel RIGHT, same grip ownership. RIGHT: walking passing phase, one boot PLANTED directly under hip, other knee bent swinging past with boot lifted behind and clear of ground; keep torso/hood/maul orientation, do not reproduce an extended contact stride. Preserve full barrel, all shaft, bells, moss, boots and original body proportions in margins. Original painterly raster, flat pure BLUE #0000FF, no spill, shadows, scenery, text/grid, effects, blood, extra characters or detached equipment.
